general.title: General
general.description: Configure instance-wide preferences including log display, keyboard shortcuts, backup retention, and data sharing.
general.localTrustedDescription: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
general.publicDescription: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
general.privateDescription: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
general.censorUsernameDescription: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
general.keyboardShortcutsDescription: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.
general.backupRetentionDescription: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
general.feedbackDescription: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
general.promptNotice: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
general.dontAllowDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
general.retestHint: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the {{feedbackKey}} key from the {{settingsRow}} JSON row for this instance, or set it back to {{promptValue}}. Unset and {{promptValue}} both mean no default has been chosen yet.
general.signOutDescription: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.

experimental.title: Experimental
experimental.warning: Experimental features may break at any time.
experimental.intro: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
experimental.warningDescription: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.
experimental.recoveryCountOne: {{count}} recovery task matches the last {{hours}} hours.
experimental.recoveryCountMany: {{count}} recovery tasks match the last {{hours}} hours.
experimental.noRecoveryNow: No recovery tasks would be created right now. Auto-recovery can still run for future liveness incidents in this window.
experimental.findingOutsideOne: {{count}} current finding is outside the configured lookback and will not be touched.
experimental.findingOutsideMany: {{count}} current findings are outside the configured lookback and will not be touched.
experimental.appsDescription: Show the Apps navigation and allow access to app connections, gateways, and advanced app tooling.
experimental.autoRecoveryDescription: Let the heartbeat scheduler create recovery tasks for task dependency chains found inside the configured lookback window.
experimental.lookbackInvalid: Lookback hours must be a whole number from 1 to 720.
experimental.autoRestartDescription: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.
experimental.betaSkillsDescription: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.
experimental.builtInAgentsDescription: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.
experimental.casesDescription: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
experimental.casesFootnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.
experimental.chatTasksDescription: Reimagines the task detail page as a live conversation with your agents: chat bubbles for people and agents, streaming activity — thinking, tool calls, diffs — that folds into a one-line summary when a turn finishes, inline plan/question/permission cards, a three-mode composer (Agent · Plan · Ask), and a resizable Properties · Plan · Artifacts pane.
experimental.chatTasksFootnote: Turning this off instantly restores the classic task page. No task data is affected.
experimental.conferenceChatDescription: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
experimental.toggleConferenceChat: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting
experimental.decisionsDescription: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.
experimental.environmentsDescription: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.
experimental.externalObjectsDescription: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
experimental.isolatedWorkspacesDescription: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.
experimental.fileViewerDescription: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.
experimental.goalsLinkDescription: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
experimental.toggleGoalsLink: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting
experimental.runWorktreeTasksDescription: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically — copied/pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
experimental.instanceMismatch: This setting was armed in a different instance and copied here, so no tasks run automatically.
experimental.missingActivationCutoff: This setting is missing its activation cutoff, so no tasks run automatically.
experimental.rearmWorktree: Toggle it off and back on to arm execution for tasks created here.
experimental.serverDebugDescription: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
experimental.toggleServerDebug: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting
experimental.simplifiedEnglishDescription: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
experimental.toggleSimplifiedEnglish: Toggle simplified english interactions experimental setting
experimental.smokeLabDescription: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.
experimental.statusCardsDescription: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
experimental.statusCardsFootnote: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.
experimental.summariesDescription: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
experimental.summariesFootnote: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.
experimental.planDecompositionDescription: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
experimental.togglePlanDecomposition: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting
experimental.watchdogsDescription: Show task detail controls for configuring watchdog agents that verify stopped task subtrees and restore live paths when work should continue.

agentChat.title: Agent Chat
agentChat.description: Talk to each agent in one ongoing conversation. Clarify goals and create tasks for execution. Chat leads the Work group and opens an agent rail beside the nav, and each chat's side panel shows the agent's tasks and artifacts as cards.
agentChat.footnote: Turning this off preserves conversations and lets active runs finish, but prevents new messages.

betaSkills.title: Beta skills
betaSkills.description: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.

builtInAgents.title: Built-in Agents
builtInAgents.description: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.

cases.title: Cases
cases.description: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
cases.footnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.

chatConnectors.title: Chat connectors
chatConnectors.description: Connect agents to Slack, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.
chatConnectors.footnote: Turning this off hides experimental chat setup and connected-task controls. Existing chat connections keep running. AgentMail, GitHub tools, and other tool connectors stay available.

combinedInboxTaskList.title: Combined Inbox + Task List
combinedInboxTaskList.description: Fold Inbox into Tasks. One Tasks row carries the unread badge, and a Views menu reaches every inbox view (Mine, Unread, Blocked, Recent, Everything) and every task view.
combinedInboxTaskList.footnote: Old Inbox links redirect to the matching view. Turning this off restores the separate Inbox; no data changes.
combinedInboxTaskList.ariaLabel: Toggle combined inbox and task list experimental setting

conferenceRoomChat.title: Conference Room Chat
conferenceRoomChat.description: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
conferenceRoomChat.ariaLabel: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.

enableEnvironments.title: Enable Environments
enableEnvironments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

enableExternalObjects.title: Enable External Objects
enableExternalObjects.description: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.

enableIsolatedWorkspaces.title: Enable Isolated Workspaces
enableIsolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

experimentalFileViewer.title: Experimental File Viewer
experimentalFileViewer.description: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.

firstTaskProposeWithAPlanDocument.title: First task: propose with a plan document
firstTaskProposeWithAPlanDocument.description: When the user's first request is a single task, the chief of staff writes a short plan document and a checkbox card instead of a one-card confirmation. Applies to organizations created after the toggle is flipped.
firstTaskProposeWithAPlanDocument.ariaLabel: Toggle first task plan proposal experimental setting

memoryConnectors.title: Memory connectors
memoryConnectors.description: Connect Mem0, Zep, Supermemory, Cognee, and Honcho for long-term memory and context.
memoryConnectors.footnote: Turning this off hides setup for these connectors. Existing connections keep running.

paperclipRunner.title: Paperclip Runner
paperclipRunner.description: Allow new Codex agents to select the experimental Rust Paperclip Runner, including authenticated runner ingress when a sandbox requires it. Onboarding continues to use legacy adapters. Turning this off hides the choice without affecting existing native runs.

simplifiedEnglishInteractions.title: Simplified English Interactions
simplifiedEnglishInteractions.description: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
simplifiedEnglishInteractions.ariaLabel: Toggle simplified english interactions experimental setting

statusCards.title: Status Cards
statusCards.description: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
statusCards.footnote: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.

streamlinedUI.title: Streamlined UI
streamlinedUI.description: Use the simplified main sidebar, shared Tasks and Inbox presentation, focused task detail layout, and contextual navigation across Agents, Routines, Skills, and Settings.
streamlinedUI.footnote: Turning this off restores the legacy shell and navigation. Task and page data are unchanged.

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
summaries.footnote: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.

useIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault.title: Use Isolated Workspaces By Default
useIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault.description: Treat a project that has no execution workspace policy of its own as if it selected isolated workspaces, so its tasks get a per-task worktree instead of sharing the project checkout. A project that carries its own policy keeps it.
useIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault.ariaLabel: Toggle isolated workspaces by default experimental setting

autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

managedEnvironmentOnly.title: Managed Environment Only
managedEnvironmentOnly.description: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.
managedEnvironmentOnly.ariaLabel: Toggle managed environment only experimental setting

paperclipDeveloperMode.title: Paperclip Developer Mode
paperclipDeveloperMode.description: Show internal Paperclip maintainer tools and observability links, including Honeycomb trace queries on run pages.
paperclipDeveloperMode.ariaLabel: Toggle Paperclip developer mode experimental setting

serverInfoDebugView.title: Server Info Debug View
serverInfoDebugView.ariaLabel: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting
serverInfoDebugView.description: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.

smokeLab.title: Smoke Lab
smokeLab.description: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.

taskPlanDecomposition.title: Task Plan Decomposition
taskPlanDecomposition.description: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
taskPlanDecomposition.ariaLabel: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting

classicTaskInterface.title: Classic Task Interface
classicTaskInterface.description: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
classicTaskInterface.footnote: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
classicTaskInterface.ariaLabel: Toggle classic task interface experimental setting

goalsSidebarLink.title: Goals Sidebar Link
goalsSidebarLink.description: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
goalsSidebarLink.ariaLabel: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting
